newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close slightly higher.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended slightly higher in extremely thin trading concentrated mostly in banking shares.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose 0.23 percent to 13,159.10 on volume of just 753.6 million pesos. Volume in Bogota, where the IBB index gained 0.21 percent to 848.99, was even lower, with 440 million pesos worth of shares traded.
"The market was very depressed today," one broker said.
"Sellers don't want to offer up their shares at such low prices and some investors have decided to pull out of stocks entirely to invest in the fixed-income market."
Colombia's high domestic interest rates continue to put a premium on fixed-income investments, she said.

More than half of Monday's trading volume in Bogota involved cross-trades between major shareholders, brokers said. One such trade, involving 61.6 million pesos of stock in Banco de Colombia, drove it down 2.09 percent.

Ordinary shares in Banco Ganadero rose 1.54 percent in Bogota, however, closing at 290 per share. An auction sale of 49.5 million pesos of already issued ordinary shares in Banco Ganadero is set to be held at 3 p.m. (2000 GMT) on Tuesday.
The auction is to facilitate the previously agreed sale of a 40 percent stake in Ganadero to Spain's banco Bilbao Vizcaya.

In Medellin, Monday's winners included insurance giant Suramericana de Seguros, which closed 500 pesos higher at 18,000 pesos per share. Banco Ganadero's preferential shares ended slightly, however, closing down one peso at 219 per share.
